sheets.title: Picnic markers and the big box

doc.blurb: a giant picnic blanket where the player is as small as a crumb
doc.style: handmade miniatures, rounded and tactile with broad soft colour areas and a gentle hint of the real material, so food looks like food, porcelain like glaze, wood like wood, in warm bright appetising colours, soft even light from the upper left, clean simple shapes.

note: Crumb Country remakes + new things, 10 Oct: the 10 kinds kept as primitives (each prompt written against the reason it lost, w1-picks.json keep), the 6 most common opening foods that were never modelled (tier C), and 6 NEW small treats for the opening (need game kinds, primitives and placement before they can ship). Cut with sheetcut.py --tol 18 --holes 8.
